text: Bit of a long one sorry, I'm shattered. My stepdaughter, 3, has had a temperature since this afternoon, it's 38.9 now. Around 7 she was sick once, just the one time, but she's had water and a bit of milk since and kept all of it down. Then about an hour ago she was running round the kitchen and bumped her head on the corner of the table. She cried straight away, proper loud, I gave her a cuddle and a cold flannel and within ten minutes she was back to normal, playing with her dolls and asking for a biscuit like nothing happened. There's a little red mark but that's it. Her neck seems fine, she was looking down at her tummy and pulling at her pyjama top and could bend her head right down without any bother. I just keep second guessing myself because it's the temperature and the sick and now the bump all in one night and her mum's not answering. Do I keep her up, do I let her sleep, what am I watching for. Thanks
